story: Stage 3 was chaotic from start to finish. Most of the sprinters got dropped on the hilly start of the stage and did not manage to get back to the front group in the flat final. All groups that managed to open up a gap on the peloton were quickly brought back. With 8 KM to go Miltiadis sensed weakness in the bunch and decided to attack. He managed to pull of an impressive solo taking the win in Lingshui ahead of Cavia and Berasategi.
